missing_methods.intent: Locate profile name element in dashboard header
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Locate and return the WebElement representing the profile name in the dashboard header. This method should wait for the element to be visible and return the element object for further operations like reading text or assertions.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'profile_name' element to be visible using wait_for(state='visible')

missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Retrieve and return the text content of the profile name element displayed in the dashboard header. This method should wait for the element to be visible, extract the text using .text property, and return it as a string.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'profile_name' element to be visible using wait_for(state='visible')
Extract text content from 'profile_name' element using .text_content() or .inner_text()
Return the extracted text as a string

missing_methods.intent: Assert displayed profile name matches expected value
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Verify that the displayed profile name in the dashboard header matches the expected value. This method should: 1) Locate the profile name element, 2) Extract its text content, 3) Compare it with the expected_name parameter using an assertion (assert or assertEqual), 4) Optionally take a screenshot for documentation. Input: expected_name (string). Returns: None or raises AssertionError if mismatch.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'profile_name' element to be visible using wait_for(state='visible')
Extract text content from 'profile_name' element using .text_content() or .inner_text()
Assert extracted text equals expected_name parameter using expect().to_have_text() or assert statement
Optionally capture screenshot for documentation using self.page.screenshot()
